model_format: Keras 3 .keras; browser integration/TF.js conversion is a separate stage
input_values: RGB pixel intensity 0..255 (do not normalize outside the model)
original_image_processing: EXIF transpose, RGB, centered letterbox to 224x224, padding RGB(128,128,128)
output: 4 softmax scores in class_names order; argmax gives predicted class
important_limitations: Unknown/non-target objects may still receive a high softmax score.
No facility-aware split; validation may be optimistic for unseen units.
